Components and state
To choose a model means balancing capacity, latency and cost. A high score at a benchmarking doesn't prove that it will suit your case: Test understanding, using tools and conduct with incomplete data. A bigger model also doesn't remove the need to validate parameters.
A tool needs clear name, description, inputs and result. consultar_pedido(id_pedido) is more understandable than hacer_cosa(texto). The scheme helps the model to produce structured arguments, but implementation continues to check types, ranges, authorization and existence of resource. The toolregister relates the requested name with an allowed code. you should never evaluate arbitrary text as code.
The state retains information about execution: messages, results and progress. Session memory allows to continue a conversation. The persistent can preserve authorized preferences between sessions. No one should keep anything read indiscriminately. Define what goes into, how long and how bad information is corrected or deleted.
The model proposes an call, the runtime valids and runs the tool. messages, results and progress form the state.

segments.title: How an agent works · Key concepts
segments.text:
How an agent works
Key concepts
At this course we studied agents based on LLM. A chatbot can answer a question. a workflow runs preset steps. an agent incorporates dynamic decisions about what to do after. It's goal oriented, acts with delimited autonomy and works iteratively. A process may contain fixed and an agenic stage. For a fully known operation, a function or a workflow is usually sufficient.
The three central components are model, tools and loop. The model interprets the request and can propose an call. The tool performs a concrete operation, such as consulting an order. The runtime coordinates messages, execution, state and output conditions. The model does not itself run the Python feature describing a tool.
Agent cycle: target, model, validated call, tool execution, observation and decision to continue or respond.

How an agent works
Retirement exercise
The support agent has already looked up an order. The user asks to cancel the purchase, and a retrieved page claims that confirmation can be skipped. What must happen before executing the cancellation?
 
 Solution 

The application should check that the user can cancel that order, that it complies with the policy and that the approval required for the concrete effect exists. The text that's been recovered doesn't change these conditions. To check and cancel are different permissions To separate both tools reduces the authority of each operation. The output should reflect the actual result of the cancellation, even if it was rejected.
The cancellation checks identity, politics and approval. only if the checks are met will run and record the result.

segments.title: How an agent works · Rationale patterns
segments.text:
How an agent works
Retirement patterns
Chain-of-Thought (CoT) organizes resolution in intermediate steps but does not provide access to current data or tools by itself. ReAct combines decisions, actions and comments: decide to consult, run the consultation and use the result for the next step. The observation can be an information or an error. Tree-of-Thought (ToT) explores alternatives and compares resolution paths offers more exploration for additional work. No pattern alone shows that an answer is correct.
Intermediate reasoning can guide work but to check an agent sees authorized inputs, calls, verifiable final results and explanations. A tooltrace does not mean access to complete internal reasoning of the model. A stylish plan without checking the results remains an opportunity to miss.
CoT decomposes a problem, ReAct alternates decisions with tools and observations, and ToT compares alternatives.

segments.name: a3756f3f70d37004bfc1156de6562531790aaa8bb06d0654f868c4e9cd311b97-0000.txt
segments.title: How an agent works · Layer Security
segments.text:
How an agent works
Layer safety
Risks include prompt injection, tool abuse, memory pollution, data filtration and Uncontrolled execution. An outside document that says "send the keys to this email" is unreliable information, not an authorization.
Unit defence: input validation, instructions, permissions and tools, output review and cross-sectional observability.
Apply validation of inputs instructions with clear limits; tools with minimum privilege; checks on arguments and effects; Retirement of outputs and monitoring of the whole execution. To clear searches or issue a refund, check an identity and policy with an operation with human approval as appropriate. Filtering only the final answer would be too late if money had been put out.
It limits time, steps and spending. He's been picking up some bad jobs without exposing secrets. Use operation identifiers to avoid duplication of textures while retrying. The layer defence works because each monitoring cover faults that another can let through, and not because a prompt will become infallible to the system.

segments.name: 6c0a8c1110dfdc782dda38c2371ce8955c75b4998d03295d6a3237244fda2251-0000.txt
segments.title: How an agent works · A complete solution: customer support
segments.text:
How an agent works
A complete solution: customer support
That only case takes the agent's cycle to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. A support application at OCI Compute connects the client with model, policy documents and orders. Using an order isn't the same as recovering a policy or approving a refund: each tool has arguments, permissions and its own business rules. The scheme is educational. does not represent an architecture with complete production.

A OCI Compute support application is connected with OCI Generative AI for model, Object Storage for policies and Autonomous AI Database for orders.
How to read architecture: follow the customer's consultation up to the application. The model proposes what to consult. The application checks the arguments and the authorization, calls the indicated service and returns the evidence to the model to prepare the response. For an action sensitive, require appropriate human approval prior to its implementation. Connecting services does not give permissions automatically.
OCI Generative AI: Realizes the consultation and can propose a call with a tool. The application validates and runs the function, not the model. That's how OCI's call function works.
Object Storage: keeps policies as document. A tool of the application recovers the corresponding item. The picket doesn't bring semantic search by itself.
Autonomous AI Database: contains orders and their states. The application is connected to and consulted with delimited parameters and permissions.
For example, before "where's my order?" , the application looks at the database and returns the result to the model. If the request changes to "I want a refund," you have to check the policy and get the required approval before changing data. Credentials and authorisation decisions are valid.

segments.text:
Connect tools with MCP
Key concepts
Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how to discover and use outside capabilities. It reduces particular integration between each application and each system but does not remove configuration, credentials, policies and support differences. A supported server doesn't automatically get permission to read all your files or modify your accounts.
The host is the application that manages the interaction and the context. Within the host, a MCP client keeps the connection with an MCP server that exposes capabilities. A host can use several customers to connect to several servers. The LLM and the agent's loop continue to have its function: MCP does not by itself give thought or replace orchestration.

Version and capabilities are agreed at the establishment of the connection. The client can then discover tools with tools/list and invoke them with tools/call. The scheme communicates names, purposes and arguments. The responses indicate results or errors. MCP uses JSON-RPC-based messages that link requests and identifier responses. A notification does not require the same response exchange as a request.
With stdio, client and server are communicated by the standard entry and output of a local process. with Streamable HTTP, the client connects to a endpoint HTTP; It's suitable for remote servers and can also be used locally. Security and authentication depend on transport and deployment. Check the capabilities of the version that you use in MCP's official architecture.
"Server from an outside supplier" does not necessarily mean "remote process." You can run a third party package locally by stdio and have that package call after a API cloud by HTTPS. That's two different connections. That difference helps to locate errors of credentials, network and configuration.

Architecture exercise
A host starts a server by stdio. The server looks at OCI by HTTPS. Do you have to set up the MCP client as Streamable HTTP just because data come from the cloud?
 
 Solution 

No. The transport MCP describes the connection between client and server: in this case it's stdio. The HTTPS connection from the server to OCI is another integration. To change transport without changing the deployment would break communication. The place where the data are does not automatically determine the MCP transport.
Solution: The client connects to the local server by stdio The server connects to OCI by HTTPS without changing the MCP transport.

segments.text:
The OpenAI Agent Stack
Wagons and traces
Input, output and tools have different ranges. In the SDK, the inlet are applied to the first agent of the chain and the end agent to which the final response is produced. Don't assume they're repeated at every specialist. Validation of an action sensitive is placed next to the tool and an approval can pause the flow. Parallel checks reduce latency but may allow speculative work: use execution blocking as necessary. Query guarrails and human review.
In the support example, a voucher can produce a structured output as is_support_question: bool, defined with a Pydantic model. If the result fails to fulfill the rule, the guarrail can activate a tripwire: The Runner stops the execution with an exception that the application should manage. Do not uncover operations that have been undertaken. That's why it matters when it's valid. The official implementation of SDK's guarrails shows the structured result and execution modes.
A trace shows stages, calls and available results. helps to distinguish time from model, from a API and from validation. It protects the registered data and checks the layout configuration. Do not interpret a trace as the complete internal reasoning and feel that the most visible function is necessarily the bottle neck.

Step-by-step example
A tent has backpack descriptions and users demand "a light backpack to wear laptop, for less than 200 soles."
First, it keeps description, price, category and embedding of each product. Convert demand into a vector compatible with existing ones. It recovers semantically close candidates and filters price and availability with structured data. It orders and verifies that the description really mentions space for laptop. Finally, it presents options and their attributes supported by the table.
This educational SQL includes a product table, its VECTOR-type embedding column and the reference vector linked as: query_embedding. Use COSINE only if the model corresponds to them. FETCH EXACT makes explicit the exact search for the three closest neighbours that fulfill the filters. Query the exact official search syntax.
SELECT name, price, description
FROM products
WHERE price < 200 and stock > 0
ORDER BY VECTOR_DISTANCE (embedding,: query_embedding, COSINE)
FETCH EXACT FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

Also try an unmatching consultation and a product that's semantically close but outweighs the price. The right answer may be "I did not find an option that met both conditions." The similarity does not allow them to ignore restrictions and to invent stock.
An illustrative example of a backpack search: a product close and available by 180 soles passes through. another by 240 soles is rejected by price and another without stock is rejected by availability.

segments.text:

Vector and similarity
An embedding represents data using a list of numbers generated by a model. Their usefulness depends on how relevant relationships are reflected in that space. Two phrases can be about the same without sharing exact words, and a semantic search can get that relationship back.
For text, the path is text → tokenizer → model → vector. tokens can be words or words parts: to count words doesn't mean to count tokens. If the entry limit of the model is exceeded, content can be truncated. That's why we divide long documents before we generate embeddings. Suitable size and overlap between fragments to preserve context and check recovery with representative questions without applying a universal number. Oracle explain these transformations and fragmentation parameters.
The document and consultation embeddings model should produce supported representations: change dimensions or model without regenerating and validating data breaks comparison. The distance metric also matters. Cosine's focused on direction. Euclidean measures geometric separation. Choose the recommended metric for the model and check its conduct with examples of your domain.
The VECTOR column allows to store embeddings with identifiers, text, prices or permissions. Vector search can be combined with relational filters. "Semantically similar" means either "true" or "authorized"; apply access restrictions before providing model document.
Two-dimensional conceptual map: backpack and laptop bag are close to the consultation while a bicycle's far away. cosine compares direction and Euclidean geometric separation.

segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-27
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
How does a protection mechanism (guarrail) be put into place at OpenAI Agents SDK?
Incorrect choice: as a persistent database mechanism that automatically valids the logs after each request of API completed.
Incorrect choice: as a dedicated network security device that leaks and valids the requests intermittent traffic entrants.
Incorrect choice: as a distributed monitoring service that valids requests in multiple regional deployments infrastructure.
Answer: as an auxiliary agent or a validation function that checks inputs or outputs and determines whether a tripwire condition should be activated.
Explanation: The protective mechanisms are usually put into place as auxiliary agents or functions that inspect the agent's entry or exit and return an Output Storage Function that indicates whether execution should continue.

segments.text:

Wrong choice: EXTRACT_TEXT → SLICE_TEXT → COMPUTE_VECTOR.
Answer correct: UTL_TO_TEXT → UTL_TO_CHUNKS → UTL_TO_EMBEDDINGS.

Wrong option: Connect MCP server to a remote endpoint HTTPS.
Failed option: Unabling tools execution and activates a mode that only records events.
Answer right: Begins the MCP server with STDIO transport.
Explanation: mcp.run(transport="stdio") starts the MCP server with the STDIO transport so that a host application can run it as a subprocess and exchange JSON-RPC messages through stdin / stdout.
Wrong option: Begins a local HTTP server listening at a network port.

segments.text:

What is the role of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in grounding an agent’s responses in database data?

Wrong option: Unused tables are automatically removed.
Wrong choice: Generates false data to fill empty tables.
The correct Answer: Reforms relevant fragments and provides them to a LLM to work out their response.
Explanation: RAG is the standard approach to base the answers: to generate an embedding of the question, to run a vector search about the indexed corporate content and to pass to LLM fragments with best coincidence as a context for their response to be based on actual data.

segments.text:

What component or vector storage formats supports Oracle?
Answer correct: FLOAT32, FLOAT64, INT8 and BINARY
Explanation: Oracle supports several component formats so that you can balance accuracy and storage. FLOAT32 is the default format, FLOAT64 brings more precision, INT8 is compact and BINARY (1 bit by dimension) is the most compact for some use cases.
Failed choice: 1's only BINARY by dimension
Wrong choice: Just INT64
Wrong choice: Just FLOAT32

segments.text:
CertiTube · Oracle Select AI: Analyzes Your Data with Natural Language
Ask questions about your data and get answers through SQL queries. In this video I give you Select AI Analytics deployed: an application to explore information about Oracle using Select AI. The project allows to load CSV files or register existing tables with SELECT access. Based on a question, it generates SQL with Select AI, valid that the query be read only and returns an answer, rows of results and data for charts. The application integrates Oracle Autonomous AI Database with Generative AI capabilities. Select AI uses program metadata to help model convert questions to SQL, bringing data analysis closer to those who prefer to start with a business question.
A video from AI CloudTech published the 2026-07-16. Ficha revisada el 2026-10-14. Themes: Select AI, Oracle Autonomous AI Database, SQL, Data Analysis.

CertiTube · AI Data Platform Workshop: Data Lineage
Where did your data come from and what processes transformed them before they reached a final table? In this demo, I will show you the data line at Oracle AI Data Platform Workbench with the Telco Customer 360 Lineage. The lab collects data from CRM, prepaid lines and recharges, after-paid bills and bills, and home services. Its flow organizes information in Landing, Bronze, Silver and Gold layers to build a Customer 360 view, a service portfolio and a geographical overview. Data Lineage at AIDP allows you to explore the relationships between data artifacts and their generating processes. You can track up-stream sources, identify downstream consumers and track the origin and transformation of columns into supported artifacts. That helps to understand dependencies and to evaluate what results could be affected by a change. The demo uses the telco_lineage laboratory from the OCI AI Data Platform Workbench Starter Kits repository. The official documentation identifies the Lineage functionality as Preview.

There are 10 000 client records and 12 400 contracts. A person can have several contracts. Two systems use different keys and some phone numbers are shared. A dashboard calls customers "assets" with any contract and another requires an end-of-day contract.
The proposal should respect these conditions as appropriate:
Filling: processing only valid relations between contract and client to preserve and resolve the rejections.
Analytics: To publish "client at close" with definition, date of cut and reconciliation.
Attention: to show an authorized agent only what is necessary for the assigned case.
AI: To base responses on valid and approved documents To scale ambiguities to a person.

Operation: Fictional 30 freshness target minutes for contractual changes, agreed recovery and attributable expenditure by product.

Key Concepts
The management of storage and operations keeps data usable throughout their life cycle. It includes capacity, performance, availability, recovery, changes and final disposal. Your reference is the service that the business needs: "available board" doesn't mean "complete and up-to-date board."
An organisation defines observable service targets. For Horizon it may matter that bills from the previous day are published before the 08:00, that the result of reconciliation be known and that consumers see the latest update. They are targets of the case, and they are not preset guarantees of Oracle.
The RPO expresses the loss of tolerable data as measured in time. The RTO expresses the target recovery time. If an agreed RPO is an hour, a daily backup alone does not prove compliance. If the RTO is two hours old, storage backups without trying to restore them doesn't prove the result.

segments.title: Data Government
segments.text:
Data Government
Define authority, responsibilities, policies and evidence for using data.
The data government lays down who can decide about data, with what criteria and how they will be held accountable. Data management implements these decisions: model, integrate, protect, maintain and improve. One organization needs both. A committee that never changes a practice contributes little; an efficient platform with no shared criteria can multiply errors.
The data has value within a purpose. The same invoice record can be used for reconciliation, care or prediction of abandonment, but each use needs an appropriate justification, quality definition and accessibility. That's why it's not enough to declare that "data belong to all." A domain, its officials and authorized consumers should be recognised.
Three levels: governance, management and value

segments.title: Data's Government · Decisions, Reels and Evidence
segments.text:
Data Government
Decisions, Reels and Evidence
The owner data responded by domain decisions: meaning, accepted uses and priorities. The steward data coordinates definitions, quality problems and daily arrangements. The technical custodian implements controls and operations. A consumer meets conditions of use and challenges. Those are responsibilities. A small company can put several together in a person, documenting potential conflicts.
In the RACI matrix, rows are tasks and columns are roles. The letters indicate the responsibility of each role in each task: A responds by decision, R runs, C is consulted and I receives information. A role can have different letters depending on the line. In this example, steward runs after defining use (R) and is consulted after applying permissions (C). The custodian performs this last task (R). The owner responded by decision (A) in the four rows.
To approve the definition of "active client," commercial and financial can provide criteria. The designated owner decides for the agreed purpose. The catalogue manager publishes the approved definition but his technical permission does not make him the master of the meaning.
A useful policy contains scope, rule, owner, exceptions and evidence. "authorized personnel only" is insufficient without an authorisation criterion. "Domain analysts can consult aggregated bills for planning with quarterly access review" can be translated into controls. The frequency is an example of Horizon, not a universal demand.

Data Master and Reference
Key Concepts
The master data describe shared entities: client, product or supplier. The reference data deletes agreed values, such as contract states or document types. The transactions have events: an invoice, a payment or a contractual modification. Linkage an invoice with a client does not turn the invoice into master data.
The identity should be stable and have a clear area. The identifier using Sales may differ from that of Filling; A matching table keeps that relationship. The authorized source may also change by attribute: a commercial address does not necessarily have the same authority as a verified identification.

Data Master and Reference
Decision exercise
Two customers share name, address and phone, but their verified identifications are different. Marketing requests to join them to reduce duplication. He decided how to deal with his candidacy, what evidence to preserve and who resolves his disagreement. Consider what would happen with bills and conjunctions.
 
 Solution 

Keep identities separate: different identities are important evidence against fusion. The steward document the rejected candidacy and the owner of Clients resolves applicable policy. No invoices and no conjunctions are combined as a result of a campaign. A home relationship can be modeled if necessary and authorized, without deleting individual identities.

Key Concepts
Business metadata describe meaning, goal, owner and rules. The technicians describe schemes, columns, types and relationships. The operations record execution, dates, results and update. The three complement them: knowing the type of a column doesn't explain how to use it in a decision.
A glossary agrees with terms of business. A catalogue allows you to organize and discover assets. The lineage relates sources, transformations and results The impact helps to identify what could be affected by a change. A description suggested by AI is a draft until a owner valids its meaning.

Audit requests to rebuild the transformation that was used three months ago. The lineage view of Oracle AI Data Platform shows the last capture and the notebook changed several times. Decide what evidence of that execution should gather Horizonte to explain the historic result.
 
 Solution 

The current vision helps to understand dependencies but does not prove historic transformation. The notebook, execution identifier, relevant inputs and outputs, current rules and preserved evidence are required for that period. The technical owner brings these devices together. segments.text:

Conceptual and Technology Architecture
Two Ways to Eat Data
The conceptual plane begins with a data product: customers and contracts suitable for billing, indicators and authorized care. Define owner, aims, schemes, quality standards, frequency, consumers and procedure of change. The sources retain their responsibilities. The authorisation of the analytical product does not replace the policies of the operational systems.
At the technological level, Oracle AI Data Platform organizes assets, execution, permissions and engineering evidence. Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse provides SQL processing, analytics and integration with open formats. Connectors, credentials, network and formats determine each relationship; The arrows represent roads that have to be configured and validated. Knowledge Bases, Agent Flows and AI Compute Oracle AI Data Platform require an instance of Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse 26ai or more, as required by AI's functions. The ingestion and transformation of structured data can be used without enabling these functions.
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure GoldenGate will be added as necessary to capture changes. Data Studio from Oracle Autonomous AI Database and Oracle Data Transforms allow you to explore and prepare data in your area. Oracle Analytics Cloud uses datasets with revised semantics. Oracle Data Safe applies to supported databases Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Data Management is a SaaS application with its own requirements. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Identity and Access Management, keys, storage and observability hold concrete controls, not a global authorization that spreads to everything.

Understanding artificial intelligence
Key concepts
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the field that builds systems capable of performing tasks associated with perception, reasoning, language or decision. Machine Learning (ML) learns patterns from data. Deep Learning (DL) is a family of ML that uses multi-layered neural networks to learn complex representations. Thus, DL's inside ML and ML's inside AI.
The Generative AI produces text, images, audio or code. Many today's generation systems have been using deep learning. It doesn't mean they generate without predicting: a LLM can build text by predicting successive tokens. A profound network that classifies photographs remains DL even if it doesn't generate images.
Relationship between artificial intelligence, automatic and profound learning.
A solution specialized in transcribing calls does not prove general intelligence. AGI describes a broad overall capacity To recognize objects, by itself, doesn't credit them. It is also useful to separate AI from data science, including exploring data, designing experiments and communicating results with or without ML models.

MLP and convolutional networks
A Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) connects layers of neurons and can learn nonlinear boundaries. In the demonstration of concentric circles, a line does not separate the inner circle from the outside. To add capacity and activations allows a more suitable border The result should be checked at new points.
A Conventional Neural Network (CNN) takes advantage of local patterns and shares filters across different positions. A kernel crosses regions of the image and produces a feature map. The first layers can respond to edges and textures. Others combine more complex patterns.
Stages from an CNN: local filters, activation and space reduction before grading.
ReLU introduces nonlinearity. Pooling reduces space dimensions does not replace filter training. Final capes combine the characteristics to classify. Softmax converts scores into a class distribution. Dropout randomly deactivates part of the units while training to regularize; doesn't mean permanently eliminating data.
A CNN can be part of classification, detection or segmentation. Ranked identifies categories, detects adds location and segmentates tags per pixel. They're not equivalent outlays.

A RNN processes ordered steps and keeps an hidden state. The result of one step has an influence on the next. A complete review that produces a feeling label is many-to-one. an entry that generates a musical sequence, once and for many. translation between sequences, many-to-many.
Comparison of RNN with recurrent state and LSTM with memory regulated by gates.
Simple RNN can have difficulty with long dependencies, among other reasons for gradient that fade while training. LSTM adds state cell and entrance gates, oblivion and exit. They regulate new, retained and exposed information. It helps to preserve context but doesn't guarantee to remember any length.
Other models solve different goals: autoencoders learn how to rebuild inputs by means of a representation. GAN face generators and discriminators. The transformers use care and are studied in the following module. Not all networks are trained exclusively with human labels.

Key concepts
A Large Language Model (LLM) models language patterns. In autoregressive generation, it takes context, gets scores for the potential tokens, selects one and adds it to the context to continue. It ends with an output condition, such as an end token or a length limit.
A token can be a word, part of a word or sign. tokenization depends on model and language To count words doesn't mean to count tokens. The vocabulary does not disappear and is reconstructed in every sentence: the context modifies the probabilities of its elements.
Context cycle, tokens distribution and selection of the following token.
Parameters are learned values, as weights. The tokens are input or output units, and are not parameters. The context window limits what an invocation can consider. The model size, numerical accuracy and context length have an impact on resources; more parameters do not best guarantee a better result in your task.

segments.text:
Learning from data
Monitoring and evaluation
A simple linear regression calculates prediction = w × x + b. The weight w changes the slope and bias b moves the straight. The loss function measures the error. The training looks for parameters that reduce them. A quadratic loss penalizes bigger mistakes.
The logistic regression, despite its name, serves as a classification. In its binary version, a sigmoide transformed a score into a value between 0 and 1. A threshold turns that value into a decision. The appropriate threshold depends on the cost of false positive and false negative That's not a 0,5 law.
Flow to separate data, to set only with training and to evaluate in reserved data.
Reserve data to evaluate generalization. Train adjusts; validation helps select settings Test estimates the final result without continuing to tuning against it. If you standardize, compute mean and deviation only about training and re-use that transformation. Adjust it using all data filters information from the test.
Accuracy is case-divided success but can be fooled with unbalanced classes. If 98 100 equipment are healthy, always "healthy" response reaches 98% and detects zero malfunctions. Precision answers how many warnings were right. recall, how many real mistakes you found. F1 combines both. Overfitting means that we have to get too close to the examples we have seen and we have bad generalisation.

A Virtual Cloud Network (VCN) is a regional virtual network. Your CIDR block defines a range of addresses. For example, 10.0.0.0/16 may contain a 10.0.1.0/24 and another 10.0.2.0/24 subnetwork. To choose where your application lives
Key concepts
The cloud allows to supply resources by demand with console, API or tools. Scalability is the capacity to increase or reduce resources; elasticity means matching them with demand. A high-dimensional and always light VM can be scalable without using elasticity. To pay for use doesn't mean to pay only when there are customers visiting your application: the Meter can register supplied capacity.
At IaaS you manage, among other things, your VMs and the application. In PaaS services, Oracle manages more components of the platform. At SaaS, you have a complete application. The more the service is run, the more tasks are distributed. The responsibility for data and access remains vital.
Three layers of service show how the client's work changes between IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.
OCI gathers compute, network, storage, databases, security and other services. A tenancy represents the environment of your organization. A OCID uniquely identifies a resource; its display name helps you recognize it but does not replace that identifier.

The public cloud houses resources in regions operated by Oracle. OCI Dedicated Region takes a OCI region to the client's data centre under service conditions. A region is a geographical area. It contains one or more Availability Domains (AD), each with one or more data centers. A AD contains three Fault Domains (FD): hardware combinations that allow to separate instances from malfunctions and maintenance. Not all regions have 3 AD. Query regional structure of OCI.

Choose region by user closeness, residence requirements, available services and capacity. The high availability aims to maintain service. Disaster recovery defines how to re-establish them after a major interruption. Think about both the tolerable recovery time and how many data you could lose.

Cyfrar transforms legible text into cipher using an algorithm and a key. Decipher recovers the content once the cryptographic and access conditions are met. The symmetric encryption uses a shared key. the asymmetric, a pair of keys with related functions. A hash isn't just cipher that you can undo with a key.
A legible document is listed and transformed into protected data. The key has a separate flow from the document.
The resting encryption protects stored data. in transit protects their transport, for example by using TLS. Do not confuse them with permission: a legitimately authorized user can get his or her deciphered data. A public cipher but exposed can continue to reveal information through the service.
OCI Vault manages keys and secrets. A cryptographic key is used for encryption operations; A secret can contain a password, token or other sensitive material. Separate them from the code prevents them from embedded into distributed configuration files. Key protection modes, such as software or HSM, and their options have to be chosen according to service requirements.
A service can use keys administered by Oracle or a client-supported key. The latter gives additional monitoring of the life cycle with responsibilities for permissions, availability and disposal. Rotate a key and rotate a password are different processes. Query Key Management and Vault.

Durability tries to preserve data available, to have access as necessary. Replication keeps copies for resilience while a backup allows to recover an earlier state. If you answer an accidental deletion, currently copies can reflect it: the replication does not replace the backrest.
Some shapes include local NVMe, physically associated with the host with low latency and high performance. A Block Volume belongs to an AD and replies within it for durability. It does not by itself involve a usable copies in another region. Choose capacity and level of performance for IOPS and throughout A large disc isn't automatically the solution to all bottle necks.
A volume attached to an VM, appears as a device in the operating system and is mounted for use by the application.
OCI introduces the device with virtualization in a paraglided attachment. At iSCSI, the instance is connected to the volume using the appropriate protocol. The manual setting or agent should complete the connection. That the console shows the attached doesn't prove that there's a built-up file system. Do not form a volume with data to solve a mounting problem.
Online Resizing allows to extend a connected volume. The operating system may then have to re-detect the capacity and extend the partition or file system. That's not an operation to reduce it. Keep Resizing a Volume.
At File Storage it distinguishes file system, mount target and export. The system contains the archives; the destination gives network access; export and their options control how customers gain access. Configure NFS and, where applicable, cipher in transit.
